messages:
ben_support: FYI — Aqueo Labs onboarding is blocked. SSO assertions failing + license mismatch. Ticket CS-9821. Getting 403 'license-not-found' when we try to provision embeddings. Need CS takeover, trial renewal in 9 days.

dmitri_csm: Copy. Can you paste the last few log lines?

ben_support: log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T16:12:03Z ERROR provisioning 403 license-not-found user=aqueo-admin tenant=aqueo corp_id=0007
2026-03-20T16:12:04Z WARN sso assertion=received ldap_id=00070 -> mapped_account=00070
```

alice_engineer: Looks like their SSO attribute `ldap_id`=00070 maps to account 00070 while their Redwood account is 0007. SSO assertion goes to the wrong account. We can either update mapping (fast) or ask customer to change SSO attr (slower). I can prepare a mapping patch, but need CS sign-off for account mapping change.

sarah_cs_manager: This is high priority. Trial customer, renewal in 9 days — risk: high if not resolved today.

jordan_account_mgr: I'll schedule a 4pm PT call today with Aqueo + legal to speed approvals. @dmitri_csm can you take comms and pre-read?

dmitri_csm: Yes. I'll draft a short comms plan and a fallback/rollback plan.

tess_se: If we map the SSO attr to account 0007 provisioning should succeed. Patch snippet: `PATCH /v1/internal/accounts/0007/mapping {"ldap_id": "00070"}`. Ready to apply during the call.

ben_support: After the first mapping attempt customer saw 500s on token exchange. Might be a KV cache TTL mismatch. Tagging @ops-bot and eng-runtime.

ops-bot: incident created: #incident-aqueo-3123456789, priority=P1, assigned to eng-runtime-oncall

carla_runtime: Looking at token-exchange logs now. Seeing refresh token TTL=0 for this tenant — that's causing immediate invalidation. Reconfiguring and will restart token worker for tenant. ETA 15m.

dmitri_csm: Comms plan (draft):
- 4pm PT call with customer + account mgr + CS
- CS owns customer-facing note explaining mapping change and temporary extension
- Eng applies mapping patch during call; if mapping fails, rollback immediately and enable a temporary bypass token for trial (max 48h)
- Post-mortem + KB within 48h
I'll post the comms draft to the customer channel after the call.

jordan_account_mgr: Sending calendar invite + pre-read now. Pre-read includes KB link and CS-9821.

carla_runtime: Restarted token worker for tenant; reprocessed recent token exchanges. Re-running provisioning checks.

ben_support: Provisioning succeeded on 2/3 attempts after restart. Customer on call confirms embed appears in their app.

dmitri_csm: Action items assigned: @tess_se apply mapping patch and document steps; @carla_runtime write root-cause blurb; @jordan_account_mgr send renewal-risk note and offer 1-month extension credit; I'll own post-mortem and customer comms.

ben_support: :thumbsup: Updating CS-9821 to 'awaiting CS follow-up' and adding incident link.

sarah_cs_manager: Great work. Dmitri — please share final comms email template and confirm extension is applied to billing portal.

dmitri_csm: Will do. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10am PT, I'll circulate notes and KB draft by EOD.
